# Stream: [Feature title — e.g. Order Export]

> Work-stream manifest. Created by `brainstorming` at stream start; each stage skill appends its
> artifact row and updates the board. The **Gate Status** zone is DERIVED — regenerated by
> `handoff` / `session-init` from `hooks/lib/sdlc_state.py`; **never hand-edit it** and it is never a
> second source of truth. This file is the orphan/gap surface: an artifact not linked here is an
> orphan; a stage missing its expected artifact is a gap.
